abstract.t:
This document specifies the Merkle commitment profile used by Proof of Stateful Integrity (PSI) receipts. It adopts the Merkle Tree Hash and inclusion proof of RFC 9162 without modification, fixes leaf order, and defines how a receipt declares the profile and how a verifier obtains and checks an inclusion proof. A valid proof shows only that a leaf was committed under a root; it says nothing about the truth or lawfulness of the sealed content.
This revision replaces the lexicographic ordering and odd-leaf duplication of revision 00, which were incompatible with RFC 9162, and withdraws all anchoring claims other than OpenTimestamps.
